description: Servizio di tesoreria comunale. L’affidamento del servizio di tesoreria oggetto del presente appalto, come previsto dall’art. 209 del D.lgs. n. 267/2000 e ss.mm.ii., è costituito dal “complesso delle operazioni legate alla gestione finanziaria dell’ente locale e finalizzate in particolare alla riscossione delle entrate, al pagamento delle spese, alla custodia di titoli e valori ed agli adempimenti connessi previsti dalla legge, dallo statuto, dai regolamenti dell’ente o da norme pattizie”. Il contratto e gli obblighi delle parti sono analiticamente descritti nella convenzione approvata con delibera di Consiglio Comunale n. 5 del 28.01.2026 e nel capitolato speciale. L’appalto è a corpo ed è costituito da un unico lotto in quanto, per le caratteristiche del servizio e le particolari modalità esecutive delle prestazioni, si rende necessaria una gestione unitaria ed omogenea da parte di un solo operatore economico, al fine di assicurare l’efficace coordinamento delle attività oggetto dell’appalto e l’ottimizzazione delle risorse. L’importo dell’appalto a base di gara per l’arco di durata quinquennale ammonta ad € 1.600.000,00 (euro unmilioneseicentomila/00), esente IVA. L’Ente ha provveduto a chiudere i dossier titoli in custodia presso la tesoreria comunale; pertanto, al ''corrispettivo omnicomprensivo del servizio di tesoreria e cassa'' si ritiene applicabile l'esenzione di cui all'articolo 10, primo comma, n. 1) del d.P.R. n. 633 del 1972 (giusta parere Agenzia delle Entrate Risposta n. 188/2023). L’importo a base di gara comprende i costi della manodopera che la stazione appaltante ha stimato pari ad € 203.580,00. In considerazione della natura del servizio oggetto della presente gara, non sussiste la necessità di procedere alla predisposizione del DUVRI ex D.lgs. 81/2008, tenuto conto altresì che il servizio si svolge presso le sedi del Tesoriere. La durata dell’appalto (escluse le eventuali opzioni) è di 5 anni naturali e consecutivi decorrenti dalla data di sottoscrizione della convenzione o dall’avvio del servizio o dalla data di esecuzione anticipata del servizio.

title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Verkauf Campusnetz
description: WISTA steht für Wissenschafts- und Wirtschaftsstandort Adlershof und ist ein hochmoderner Technologiepark im Berliner Ortsteil Adlershof (Bezirk Treptow-Köpenick). Er gilt als einer der fortschrittlichsten Hochtechnologieparks Europas und ist ein zentraler Ort für Wissenschaft, Wirtschaft und Gründungen. WISTA Adlershof als Standort mit ca. 4,2 km² Fläche, ca. 1.300 Unternehmen, Forschungseinrichtungen und Hochschulinstituten mit 28.000 Mitarbeitenden, Die WISTA Management GmbH agiert als Standortentwickler, Dienstleister und Wirtschaftsförderer. Sie unterstützt Unternehmen, Forschungseinrichtungen und Start-ups am Standort und fördert Innovation und Wachstum in der Region. Neben ihrem Immobilienbestand verfügt WISTA über ein eigenes Campusnetz, das aus einem leistungsfähigen Kabelnetz sowie einer 5G-Infrastruktur besteht. Das Netz wurde seit 1998 kontinuierlich ausgebaut und technologisch weiterentwickelt – von klassischen Telefonie- und Datendiensten über Gigabit- und 10G-Anbindungen, Cloud- und UCC-Integration, campusweites WLAN und IoT-Anwendungen bis hin zu lokalem 5G und aktuellen Netzwerk-4.0-Themen. Es bildet damit eine wesentliche digitale Infrastruktur des Campus und ist Gegenstand des Interessenbekundungsverfahrens. Die Attraktivität des Campusnetzes ergibt sich aus seiner etablierten Telekommunikationsinfrastruktur an einem dynamisch wachsenden Hochtechnologiestandort. Das Netz verfügt über eine bestehende Kundenbasis, gewachsene Leitungswege und Netzknoten sowie redundante Carrier-Anbindungen. Zusätzliche Entwicklungsperspektiven ergeben sich aus der fortlaufenden Erweiterung des Campus durch neue Gebäude, dem Ausbaupotenzial für Cloud-, Security- und UCC-Dienste sowie der Ergänzung durch ein lokales 5G-Campusnetz. Damit bietet das Campusnetz eine belastbare infrastrukturelle Grundlage mit weiterem wirtschaftlichem und technologischem Wachstumspotenzial. Die Beweggründe für den Verkauf durch die WISTA sind eine strategische Weiterentwicklung des Campusnetzes durch einen spezialisierten Provider, mit qualifiziertem Personal und dem notwendigen Knowhow. Verkaufsgegenstand: Passive Infrastruktur (LWL, Kupfer, Rohre, Schächte, Kabelverzweiger, Hausanschlüsse) Aktive Infrastruktur (Switche, Router, Server, TK-System) Kundenverträge (soweit übertragbar, Zustimmung/ Überleitungen müssen noch geprüft werden) Frequenzzuteilung 5G (nicht veräußerbar, Nachnutzung/ Übertragung noch regulatorisch zu prüfen, Beantragung eigener Zuteilung erforderlich) Grundstücks-/Leitungsrechte (soweit übertragbar, Dienstbarkeiten/Gestattungen noch zu prüfen) Software/Lizenzen (soweit übertragbar, Lizenzbedingungen noch zu prüfen) Kabelnetz: Das WISTA-Campusnetz am Wissenschafts- und Wirtschaftsstandort Adlershof bildet die zentrale Kommunikationsinfrastruktur für Sprach- und Datendienste im Kerngebiet des Technologieparks. Es versorgt derzeit rund 400 Kunden sowie ca. 4.400 Teilnehmer im Voice-Bereich und ist damit ein wesentlicher Standortfaktor für Deutschlands größten Wissenschafts- und Technologiepark. Die vorhandene Infrastruktur umfasst eine leistungsfähige Kabelkanalanlage, ein Leitungsnetz auf Kupfer- und Glasfaserbasis, mit einer Gesamtlänge von knapp 20 Kilometern, sowie ein Gigabit-Ethernet-Backbone. Technisch genutzt werden insbesondere LWL-Backbone-Verbindungen, Monomode- und Multimode-Glasfaserkabel, Kupferkabel, Kupfer-Querkabel sowie FM-Kabel mit 100 Doppeladern. Auf der aktiven Netz- und Dienste Ebene umfasst das Campusnetz Übertragungs- und Vermittlungseinrichtungen für Sprach- und Datenkommunikation, Routing-/Switching-Komponenten, Datencore- und Accessbereiche, Netzübergänge in Weitverkehrsnetze sowie einen Kommunikationsverbund aus Kommunikationssystemen des Herstellers Unify. Die vorhandene Sprach- und Dateninfrastruktur der Nutzer ist an das Netz angeschlossen; ein Teil der Nutzer ist über LAN-Anschlüsse unter 100 Mbit/s bzw. VDSL angebunden, weitere Nutzer verfügen über Anschlüsse ab 100 Mbit/s. Die WAN-Anbindung ist redundant mit mindestens zwei externen Carriern ausgelegt und verfügt über zwei redundante Übergänge mit 100 Gbit/s. Das Campusnetz ist insbesondere als etablierte, betreiberfähige Infrastruktur mit bestehender Kundenbasis, vorhandenen Leitungswegen, dokumentierten Netzübergängen und Entwicklungspotenzial interessant. Der künftige Betreiber soll das Netz eigenverantwortlich betreiben, instand halten, fortentwickeln und gegenüber den Nutzern aktiv vermarkten. Wertrelevant sind neben der bestehenden Kupfer-, LWL- und Glasfaserinfrastruktur insbesondere die Bestandskunden, die vorhandenen TK- und Datennetzkomponenten, die Ausbaupotenziale am wachsenden Standort Adlershof sowie die Möglichkeit zur Einführung neuer Cloud-, Security-, VoIP- und UCC-Dienste. 5G-Netz: Das WISTA 5G-Campusnetz ist als lokales privates 5G-Campusnetz am Wissenschafts- und Wirtschaftsstandort Adlershof konzipiert. Es dient als Ergänzung der bestehenden Kabelinfrastruktur und soll sukzessive an Outdoor- und Indoor-Standorten ausgebaut werden. Ein initialer Ausbau ist im Bereich Albert-Einstein-Straße 16 (zentraler Outdoor-Standort) sowie im Showroom/a:head-Kontext (Indoor-Standort) vorgenommen worden. Regulatorische Grundlage der 5G-Infrastruktur ist eine lokale Frequenzzuteilung der Bundesnetzagentur für den Frequenzbereich 3.700–3.800 MHz. Zuteilungsinhaberin ist die WISTA Management GmbH. Die zugeteilte Bandbreite beträgt 100 MHz; die Frequenzzuteilung ist bis zum 20.02.2030 befristet. Das Zuteilungsgebiet umfasst eine Fläche von ca. 0,873273 km². Technologisch basiert die 5G-Infrastruktur auf einer Nokia DAC/NDAC Medium+ Umgebung mit 5G Standalone-Architektur, Edge Core, NDAC-Manager, Nokia AirScale-Komponenten, HPE Edge Servern, Router- und Switching-Komponenten sowie SIM-Kit.

title: Leverich Helio Stewardship IRSC
description: Sources Sought (SS) / Request for Information (RFI) This Sources Sought / Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for market research and planning purposes. It does not constitute a solicitation or a promise to issue a solicitation in the future. The Government will not reimburse accompanying costs. Any answers or attachments provided are based upon the best information available at the time of the visit and are subject to change. 1. Background & Purpose USDA Forest Service seeks capability statements from qualified vendors able to conduct fuels reduction on steep and rugged terrain within Bozeman Municipal Watershed Project area for the anticipated Leverich Helio Stewardship IRSC. The purpose of this SS/RFI is to gather information on vendor capabilities, invite prospective vendors to an organized site visit on 10/01/2026, and to view the area before snow limits access. 2. Anticipated Scope of Work Cut and removal of approximately 290 CCF of Lodgepole pine sawtimber 2045 CCF of Douglas-fir and other Sawtimber on 151 acres. Whole-tree Helicopter yarding of included timber. Piling of slash at the landing area. Road Decommissioning of .59 miles of existing Temporary Road Use Permit (TRUP) roads post-hauling. 3. Place of Performance The Leverich Helio Stewardship IRSC project is located in the northern Gallatin Mountain Range, just south of Bozeman, MT. Helicopter units are located on the west side of FS Road #979, along Bozeman Creek and adjacent to City of Bozeman land. 4. Period of Performance Anticipated start date: Late Spring/Early Summer 2027. Period of performance is estimated to not exceed two operational seasons and is dependent on weather, access, and coordination. 5. Site Visit An organized site visit will occur on Thursday, October 1, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. MDT. Interested parties will meet at the Bozeman Ranger District located at 3710 Fallon St. Suite C. Bozeman, MT 59718. Interested parties should contact Nathan Motzko at nathan.motzko@usda.gov or 406-224-0323 by 12:00 p.m. MDT on September 30, 2026, if they intend to attend. 6. Requested Capability Statement Content Company information (UEI, address, email, POC, socio-economic status). Relevant experience, especially hazardous fuel reduction, helicopter yarding, steep slope timber operations. Safety program details and crew qualifications. Equipment lists and mobilization capabilities. Past performance references. 7. Response Instructions & Due Date Any information submitted by vendors to this this SS/RFI is voluntary. Responses should be submitted electronically to Jeanne Windle at norma.windle@usda.gov. All responses are due no later than October 15, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. MDT. 8. Points of Contact Direct all questions via email to Jeanne Windle, Contracting Officer at norma.windle@usda.gov.

title: Rammeavtale for kjøp av næringsmiddelgass
description: Anskaffelsen gjelder rammeavtale for kjøp av næringsmiddelgass til Lillestrøm kommune, Nittedal kommune og Aurskog-Høland kommune (heretter samlet kalt oppdragsgiver). Avtalen skal dekke oppdragsgivers løpende behov for næringsmiddelgass, inkludert levering, leie av gassflasker og service- og kontroll av gassanlegg. Lillestrøm kommune inngår og forvalter avtalen på vegne av de deltakende kommunene. Estimert samlet kjøp over fire år for alle tre deltakere estimeres til ca kr 2 080 000,-. Oppdragsgiver informerer om at Nittedal og Aurskog-Høland kommune er nye områder i avtalen og at man derfor ikke har tidligere erfaringstall på forbruk, men at behovet forventes å være økende. Volumangivelser er kun retningsgivende og forplikter ikke oppdragsgiver. For å hensynta KPI-justeringer, stor usikkerhet beheftet med oppgitt estimat og endrede behov, settes maksimalt omfang på denne avtalen til: 3 948 000,-. Anskaffelsen gjennomføres i henhold til lov om offentlige anskaffelser av 17.06.2016 nr. 73 og forskrift om offentlige anskaffelser av 12.08.2016 nr. 974, del I og III, samt de bestemmelser som framgår av dette konkurransegrunnlaget. Konkurransen gjennomføres som en åpen anbudskonkurranse. I en åpen anbudskonkurranse kan alle interesserte leverandører gi tilbud.

title: Rahmenvertrag zur Pflege der vegetativen Flächen im Stadtgebiet Bornheim in 2 Losen

title: Centrum současného umění a architektury (Dům umění) – rekonstrukce objektu – Etapa I
description: Objednatel (město České Budějovice) se rozhodl zrealizovat rekonstrukci „Domu umění“ a vytvořit zde Centrum současného umění a architektury (CSUA), na které má již zpracovanou projektovou dokumentaci do stupně provedení stavby z 07/2023 s platností povolení stavby do 5ti let od nabytí právní moci. Vzhledem k limitovaným finančním zdrojům objednatele a k významnému nárůstu předpokládaných nákladů stavby v čase, zejména v důsledku inflace a vývoje cen stavebních prací a dodávek od ukončení soutěže o návrh v roce 2021, je objednatel nucen realizaci stavby rozdělit do dvou etap. Tato změna investičního záměru je reflektována v rozdělení a úpravě původní dokumentace tak, že umožňuje realizaci stavby v etapách při zachování bezpečnosti, provozuschopnosti a funkčnosti 1. etapy. Z hlediska nosné konstrukce a obálky bude stavba zrealizována celá. Cílovým stavem 1. etapy je plné zprovoznění 1. a 2. nadzemního podlaží objektu, včetně všech nezbytných stavebních a technických opatření potřebných pro bezpečný a řádný provoz této části stavby. Vyšší patra, tedy 3.-5. nadzemní podlaží, budou v rámci 1. etapy ponechána ve stavu hrubé stavby s přípravou napojovacích bodů TZB pro budoucí vestavbu (tzv. „shell and core“). Jelikož je terasa v 5.NP součástí obálky a z hlediska požární bezpečnosti je možné ji zpřístupnit, je i ta součástí Etapy 1. Předmětem plnění veřejné zakázky je zrealizovat dílo pod názvem „Centrum současného umění a architektury“ (Dům umění) – rekonstrukce objektu“ vymezené projektovou dokumentací pod názvem „DUCB – DŮM UMĚNÍ ČESKÉ BUDĚJOVICE – DPS ETAPA I., zpracované projekční kanceláří Malý Chmel s.r.o. se sídlem Jungmannova 697/46, České Budějovice 7, 370 01 České Budějovice, IČO: 09674411. Jedná se o kompletní rekonstrukci objektu, která zahrnuje zejména bourací práce, úpravy dle architektonicko stavebního a stavebně konstrukčního řešení, provedení nové techniky prostředí staveb (zdravotně technické instalace; silnoproudé a slaboproudé rozvody – EPS, EZS, data a světelná technika, stabilní hasící zařízení; vzduchotechnika a chlazení; vytápění; měření a regulace) a provedení provizorních opatření pro zajištění prostor, které budou realizovány v ETAPĚ 2.

title: TD2414 - Asbestos Removal and Remediation Services and Asbestos Analyst Services
description: Derby City Council (the Council) is undertaking this procurement to establish two contracts: • Lot 1 Asbestos removal and remediation services • Lot 2 Asbestos analyst services The procurement process adopted by the Council is based on the 'Open' tendering procedure as detailed in the Procurement Act 2023 (the "Act") and the Procurement Regulations 2024 (the "Regulations".) For Lot 1 the asbestos removal and remediation services contract, the initial contract period is two years and is estimated to commence on 1st February 2027 and expire on 31st January 2029. For Lot 2 the asbestos analyst services contract, the initial contract period is two years and is estimated to commence on 13th February 2027 and expire on 12th February 2029. For both contracts there will be an option to extend the contract for three (3) years in annual increments, subject to satisfactory performance and business needs. Maximum contract period is five (5) years. Local Government Reorganisation (LGR) is underway in several areas across the country and may result in changes to council structures, service delivery and responsibilities, and geographical coverage during the life of the contract. For this contract it is anticipated that the effects of LGR may lead to an increased service demand or the need to extend provision to new areas or client groups. For Lot 1 the asbestos removal and remediation services contract, bidders should note that the total estimated contract value of £1,172,000, comprises of two components: i) The core contract value, estimated at £293,000, based on known current service requirements ii) An additional estimated value of £879,000 to reflect potential future changes in service scope or volume linked to LGR. For Lot 2 the asbestos analyst services contract, bidders should note that the total estimated contract value of £2,616,000, comprises of two components: i) The core contract value, estimated at £654,000, based on known current service requirements ii) An additional estimated value of £1,962,000 to reflect potential future changes in service scope or volume linked to LGR. These figures are estimations and due to only being in the early stages of the process the Authority cannot give any commitment on these figures but would like to build scope into the Contract should the need arise.

description: Předmětem plnění veřejné zakázky je zajištění projektových a inženýrských služeb pro technickou a dopravní infrastrukturu projektu výstavby nového centrálního okrsku městské části Praha 6 – Nebušice s několika navzájem provázanými objekty a veřejnými prostory (dále jen „Projekt“). description: Ordregiver er Boligforeningen AAB, afdeling 62, herefter benævnt ”AAB”. AAB ønsker at gennemføre en samlet renovering af afdeling 62, beliggende Tovværkgade 5 B, 2300 København S. Ejendommen er opført i 1880 som pakhus og er senere ombygget til ungdomsboliger. Afdelingen består af 32 lejemål fordelt på to opgange. Nærværende udbud omfatter totalrådgivning i forbindelse med renoveringen. Projektet omfatter blandt andet udskiftning af vinduer og altandøre, udskiftning af tag, renovering af facade, modernisering af badeværelser, udskiftning af tekøkkener, etablering/opretning af balanceret ventilation, udskiftning af varmecentral samt vand- og afløbsinstallationer og miljøregistrering og -sanering. Herudover indgår etablering af et nyt tagintegreret PV-system. Totalrådgiveren skal varetage den samlede rådgivning, herunder projektering, tværfaglig koordinering, budgettering og budgetopfølgning, udbud af entreprisearbejderne samt rådgivning i forbindelse med udførelsen. Projektet er faseopdelt. Efter udarbejdelse af byggeprogrammet skal totalrådgiveren udarbejde et opdateret anlægsbudget, som sammenholdes med det af afdelingen godkendte anlægsbudget. Projektets videreførelse til efterfølgende faser er betinget af AAB’s godkendelse, hvis det opdaterede anlægsbudget overstiger den godkendte økonomiske ramme. Tilsvarende skal totalrådgiveren efter licitation vurdere de indkomne entreprisetilbud i forhold til det godkendte anlægsbudget og, hvis nødvendigt, udarbejde forslag til besparelser, prioriteringer eller projektændringer.

title: Viittomakielisten tulkkausten ja käännösten hankinta valtioneuvostolle
description: Valtioneuvoston kanslia (VNK) on yksi 12 ministeriöstä. Sen päätehtävä on tukea pääministeriä valtioneuvoston johtamisessa sekä hallituksen ja eduskunnan työn yhteensovittamisessa. VNK vastaa valtioneuvoston toiminnan organisoinnista ja hallituksen toimintaedellytysten järjestämisestä kaikissa olosuhteissa. Hankinnan kohteena ovat valtioneuvoston ja sen ministeriöiden tarvitsemien suomalaisen ja suomenruotsalaisen viittomakielen tulkkaus- ja käännöspalveluiden hankinta. Tulkkaus- ja käännöspalveluita tarvitaan pääsääntöisesti suomesta ja/tai ruotsista suomalaiselle ja suomenruotsalaiselle viittomakielelle, mutta jonkin verran myös suomalaisesta ja suomenruotsalaisesta viittomakielestä suomeksi. Viittomakielisiä tulkkaus- ja käännöspalveluita tarvitaan erityisesti 1.7.2026 valtioneuvoston kansliassa aloittaneen valtioneuvoston viestintäosaston tarpeisiin. Valtioneuvoston viestintäosasto vastaa valtioneuvoston ja sen ministeriöiden viestinnästä ja valtionhallinnon viestinnän yhteensovittamisesta. Suositus viittomakielten käytöstä valtioneuvoston viestinnässä 2025 edistää viittomakielisten kielellisten oikeuksien toteutumista. Viestintään liittyvien tulkkaus- ja käännöspalveluiden lisäksi hankinnan kohteena ovat myös ministeriöiden muut viittomakieliset tulkkaus- ja käännöstarpeet (osa-alueet 5-8), joiden hankinnassa valtioneuvoston kanslia toimii hankintarenkaan vetäjänä ja hankintarenkaassa ovat mukana liikenne- ja viestintäministeriö, oikeusministeriö, opetus- ja kulttuuriministeriö, sosiaali- ja terveysministeriö, ulkoministeriö ja valtiovarainministeriö sekä oikeuskanslerinvirasto. Tulkkaukset ja käännökset voivat koskea mitä tahansa ministeriöiden toimialoihin kuuluvaa asiaa, ks. valtioneuvoston ohjesääntö 262/2003, § 10–24, https://www.finlex.fi/fi/laki/ajantasa/2003/20030262. Lisätietoa ministeriöiden toiminnasta on saatavilla ministeriöiden www-sivustoilla, ks. https://valtioneuvosto.fi/ministeriot Hankinta on EU-kynnysarvon ylittävä palveluhankinta ja se on jaettu kahdeksaan osa-alueeseen: 1. Tiedotustilaisuuksien tulkkaukset suomesta suomalaiselle viittomakielelle 2. Tiedotustilaisuuksien tulkkaukset suomesta ja ruotsista suomenruotsalaiselle viittomakielelle 3. Viestintään liittyvät käännökset suomesta suomalaiselle viittomakielelle 4. Viestintään liittyvät käännökset ruotsista suomenruotsalaiselle viittomakielelle 5. Muut tulkkaukset suomesta suomalaiselle viittomakielelle ja suomalaisesta viittomakielestä suomeksi 6. Muut tulkkaukset suomesta ja ruotsista suomenruotsalaiselle viittomakielelle ja suomenruotsalaisesta viittomakielestä suomeksi ja ruotsiksi 7. Muut käännökset suomesta suomalaiselle viittomakielelle 8. Muut käännökset ruotsista suomenruotsalaiselle viittomakielelle Tarjoaja voi tehdä tarjouksen yhdelle tai useammalle osa-alueelle. Kullekin osa-alueelle perustetaan puitejärjestely, jossa valitut toimittajat on asetettu etusijajärjestykseen. Hankinnan ennakoitu arvo on kaikki kielet yhteenlaskettuna noin 100 000 euroa/vuosi. Valittavien toimittajien kanssa tehdään kahden vuoden (24 kk) puitesopimus, joka sisältää kaksi yhden (1) vuoden optiota. Sopimuskauden arvioitu alkamisajankohta on 1.11.2026., 1. description: Předmětem plnění veřejné zakázky je zajištění projektových a inženýrských služeb pro technickou a dopravní infrastrukturu projektu výstavby nového centrálního okrsku městské části Praha 6 – Nebušice s několika navzájem provázanými objekty a veřejnými prostory (dále jen „Projekt“). Zpracování dokumentace pro povolení záměru podle stavebního zákona v rozsahu umožňujícím podání bezvadné žádosti o povolení záměru 4. Zajištění kompletní inženýrské činnosti směřující k vydání pravomocného povolení záměru 5. description: Ordregiver er Boligforeningen AAB, afdeling 62, herefter benævnt ”AAB”. AAB ønsker at gennemføre en samlet renovering af afdeling 62, beliggende Tovværkgade 5 B, 2300 København S. Ejendommen er opført i 1880 som pakhus og er senere ombygget til ungdomsboliger. Afdelingen består af 32 lejemål fordelt på to opgange. Nærværende udbud omfatter totalrådgivning i forbindelse med renoveringen. Projektet omfatter blandt andet udskiftning af vinduer og altandøre, udskiftning af tag, renovering af facade, modernisering af badeværelser, udskiftning af tekøkkener, etablering/opretning af balanceret ventilation, udskiftning af varmecentral samt vand- og afløbsinstallationer og miljøregistrering og -sanering. Herudover indgår etablering af et nyt tagintegreret PV-system. Totalrådgiveren skal varetage den samlede rådgivning, herunder projektering, tværfaglig koordinering, budgettering og budgetopfølgning, udbud af entreprisearbejderne samt rådgivning i forbindelse med udførelsen. Projektet er faseopdelt. Efter udarbejdelse af byggeprogrammet skal totalrådgiveren udarbejde et opdateret anlægsbudget, som sammenholdes med det af afdelingen godkendte anlægsbudget. Projektets videreførelse til efterfølgende faser er betinget af AAB’s godkendelse, hvis det opdaterede anlægsbudget overstiger den godkendte økonomiske ramme. Tilsvarende skal totalrådgiveren efter licitation vurdere de indkomne entreprisetilbud i forhold til det godkendte anlægsbudget og, hvis nødvendigt, udarbejde forslag til besparelser, prioriteringer eller projektændringer.

description: ROMI (Return on marketing Investment) tool The object of the procurement is Return On Marketing Investments (ROMI) tool and Marketing Performance Measurement as a SaaS solution. Purpose of the tool is to analyze and optimize marketing strategies and actions. Veikkaus is looking for a ROMI modelling software, which can model, how the marketing investments on offline and online marketing channels affects gaming revenue, and based on the modelling can forecast the optimal allocation to different marketing channels. Additionally, Veikkaus is looking for tool for marketing performance measurement. The procurement also covers support and expert services associated with the solution.,

title: APN - Housing Construction Plan
description: Advance Procurement Notice Housing Construction plan Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. This is an advance notice for potential contracts to provide interested Design-Builders an opportunity to learn about the upcoming housing construction program. Note that there is no guarantee that these solicitations will proceed. Description of the Program and Services The Canadian Forces Housing Agency (CFHA) is planning a Housing Program to support the delivery of new residential housing for members of the Canadian Armed Forces at bases and wings across Canada. CFHA is responsible for the provision and management of military housing on Department of National Defence (DND) lands, and this program supports ongoing efforts to modernize and expand the housing portfolio to meet current and future operational needs. The objective of the program is to deliver new housing efficiently and at speed through Modified Design -Build (MDB) delivery model that integrates studies, design and construction under a single contract. The services required under this program include: Architectural & Engineering (A&E) services for the provision site studies, planning and detailed design development and all associated works. Design and construction of new infrastructure and housing to support the residential housing program. Note that certain locations may involve phased delivery. Planned building types will emphasize higher-density development, primarily mid-rise apartment buildings. The proposed number of units at each location is subject to adjustment as requirements are finalized. It is anticipated that each location will be delivered under its own Modified Design-Build (MDB) contract. However, subject to change, certain locations may be bundled and procured through a single Request for Proposals (RFP), as outlined below in no particular order. Location / Proposed Number of Housing Units / Estimated Design and Construction Costs ($M) RFP No.1 (Published) Comox, British Columbia/ 212 units/ $96M Esquimalt, British Columbia/ 200 units/ $91M RFP No.2 (Published) Ottawa, Ontario/ 280 units/ $128M RFP No.3 (Published) Yellowknife, Northwest Territories/ 32 units / $15M RFP No.4 (Published) Gagetown, New Brunswick/ 656 units / $323M Greenwood, Nova Scotia/ 208 units / $95M Halifax, Nova Scotia/ 400 units /$182M RFP No.5 (Published) Montreal, Quebec/ 200 units/ $91M Valcartier, Quebec/ 1120 units/ $510M Bagotville, Quebec/240 units/ $109M It is anticipated that the following solicitations related to this program will be initiated in Fall 2026. This is conditional on receiving approval to proceed by the Department of National Defence (DND). RFP No.6 Wainwright, Alberta/ 94 units/ $43M Cold Lake, Alberta/ 232 units/ $106M Edmonton, Alberta/ 1010 units/ $459M RFP No.7 Winnipeg, Manitoba/ 240 units/ $110M Shilo, Manitoba/ 184 units/ $84M RFP No.8 Borden, Ontario/ 210 units / $96M Kingston, Ontario/ 960 units/ $437M North Bay, Ontario/ 78 units/ $36M Petawawa, Ontario/ 1114 units/ $507M RFP No.9 Moose Jaw, Saskatchewan/ 24 units/ $11M The Government of Canada is committed to advancing reconciliation and fostering meaningful engagement with Indigenous Peoples. In alignment with these commitments, the Department of National Defence (DND) seeks to create opportunities for Indigenous businesses and communities through (sub)contracting, employment, and training initiatives associated with the proposed program of work. It is anticipated that Indigenous communities will benefit from potential subcontracting, employment, and training opportunities arising from this program of work. Questions Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Antoine am Rhyn Regional Service Line Leader, Contract Services Defence Construction Canada 819-431-7650 Antoine.amrhyn@dcc-cdc.gc.ca    Bidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. Fees may apply; See https://www.merx.com/public/pricing for more information.

description: De salarisadministratie is momenteel uitbesteed aan een externe partij, die deze werkzaamheden uitvoert voor circa 10 tot 12 uur per week en, indien nodig, ad hoc consultancydiensten. Deze partij is verantwoordelijk voor de periodieke salarisverwerking en aanverwante werkzaamheden zoals beschreven in Bijlage F – Werkzaamheden. De personeelsadministratie is ondergebracht binnen team HR, onderdeel van de afdeling HR & Organisatieontwikkeling en wordt uitgevoerd door drie parttime medewerkers. Zij zijn verantwoordelijk voor het aanleveren, controleren en verwerken van verschillende personeelsmutaties. Sinds januari 2023 wordt gewerkt met het systeem AFAS. Een groot deel van de HR- en salarisprocessen is ingericht via workflows binnen dit systeem. title: France – Mine warfare and auxiliary ships – Fourniture de drones navals de surface d’endurance embarqués, mis en œuvre depuis des bâtiments de la Marine Nationale, et réalisation de prestations associées
description: Le marché consiste à acquérir des drones d’endurance à des fins de recueil de renseignement et d’établissement de situation tactique au-dessus et en dessous de la surface. Les drones doivent être embarquables et mise en œuvre depuis des bâtiments de la Marine Nationale (par exemple de type PHA, BSAM), de jour comme de nuit. Le drone peut être appréhender comme une plateforme comportant, diverses charges utiles et un système C2 et doit être modulaire et évolutif. Il doit être livré avec les interfaces permettant son intégration au bâtiment porteur. Le drone doit avoir une élongation d’au moins 100 nq et une autonomie de 5 à 10 jours en fonction de sa mission. Il doit être capable de conduire sa mission jusqu’à mer 4 minimum. Il s’agit d’un marché composite (pouvant comporter, outre une partie forfaitaire, une partie à bons de commande et une partie provisionnelle). La quantité maximale de drones visée est de quelques dizaines.

title: Germany – Architectural services for buildings – BAL201001/2027 Dach- und energetische Sanierung Gebäude C und D, Philipp-Matthäus-Hahn-Schule
description: Die Planungsleistungen umfassen eine Dach- und energetische Sanierung der Philipp-Matthäus-Hahn-Schule in Balingen. Die zu sanierenden Gebäude C und D wurden in den Jahren 1978/1979 errichtet. Die beiden miteinander verbundenen Gebäude umfassen eine Nutzfläche von mehr als 6.000 m² und beherbergen überwiegend Werkstätten und Unterrichtsräume. Sie sind eingeschossig, nicht unterkellert und wurden in Massivbauweise mit Stahlbetontragwerk, Flachdächern und Sheddach-Elementen errichtet. Ein zweigeschossiger Holzlagerraum mit flach geneigtem Blechdach wurde 2005 an das Gebäude C angebaut. Die Baumaßnahme soll während des laufenden Schulbetriebs durchgeführt werden. Schmutz- und lärmintensive Arbeiten sind daher, soweit möglich, in die schulfreien Zeiten (z. B. Ferien oder unterrichtsfreie Nachmittage) zu legen. Die gesamte Aufgabenbeschreibung finden Sie in der Anlage 01 Verfahrensleitfaden. Die Fertigstellung und die Übergabe an die Schule sind spätestens für Dezember 2032 geplant.

title: USACE National Enterprise Dredging Center Scope Dredge to Budget Contract
description: Special Notice: W912PM27RA006 Title: Virtual Industry Day for FY27 USACE Enterprise Dredge Delivery Center Scope Dredge to Budget The Virtual Industry Day Meeting for the USACE Enterprise Dredge Delivery Center Scope Dredge to Budget will occur on 16 October 2026 from 0900ET to 13:00ET via Teams. All interested dredging companies are encouraged to attend. During the meeting, we will be discussing Scope Dredge to Budget acquisition strategy. Scope Dredge to Budget: Optimize the Budget in terms of quality, scope, durability with innovative betterments and betterments within the budget. title: Sepsis Research Blood Sample Collection Services
description: Notice of Intent (NOI) to Sole Source Title: Sepsis Research Blood Sample Collection Services Requiring Activity: Walter Reed Army Institute of Research (WRAIR), Integrative Systems Biology (ISB) Branch Related Notice: HT942523P0084 Product Service Code (PSC): AN11 - HEALTH R&D SERVICES; HEALTH CARE SERVICES; BASIC RESEARCH North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code: 541714 - Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology) Small Business Size Standard: 1000 employees The Defense Health Agency Contracting Activity (DHACA) on behalf of the Integrative Systems Biology (ISB) Branch at the Walter Reed Army Institute of Research (WRAIR) intends to extend current contract services as a cost R&D contract on a sole source basis to Medstar Health Research Institute, Inc. (MHRI), 10980 Grantchester Way 7th Fl, Columbia, MD 21044-6097 USA; Cage Code 3J1M2 under the RFO FAR 6.103-1 � Only one responsible source can supply the required products due to the non-commercially available sources of the blood samples the Government is requesting. Description of Requirement: This is a requirement to extend and re-structure a Firm-Fixed Price contract into a Research and Development (R&D) cost type contract vehicle that will allow the Integrative Systems Biology (ISB) Branch to procure samples from septic and non-septic burn patients along with longitudinal clinical data for the assessment of biomarkers of sepsis for refinement and validation of SeptiBurnAlert program. These blood samples; to include longitudinal clinical data, are currently being collected by MHRI in accordance with an approved Institutional Review Board (IRB) protocol and are actively recruiting subjects for patient samples that meet the specific thermally injured criteria. The Government will convert the current contract from a firm fixed price award to a cost type, RFO part 35 R&D contract to better align the requirement with the Government�s needs. This special notice of intent is not a request for competitive proposals, and no solicitation document exists for this requirement. Meaningful submissions received in response to this notice will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether competitive procurement is in the best interest of the Government. If no meaningful, written submissions are received by the date listed below, after the publication of this notice, the solicitation will be issued as a sole source requirement to Medstar Health Research Institute, Inc. Based on the above information, the only technically acceptable vendor to fulfill this requirement is MHRI. Submit capability statements (using PDF, MS Word, or Excel attachments) to Ms. Nicole Applegate at e-mail: nicole.v.applegate.civ@health.mil Capability statements are due no later than 10:00am Eastern Time on October 15, 2026.

title: Germany – Engineering services – BAL201001/2027 Dach- und energetische Sanierung Gebäude C und D, Philipp-Matthäus-Hahn-Schule
description: Die Planungsleistungen umfassen eine Dach- und energetische Sanierung der Philipp-Matthäus-Hahn-Schule in Balingen. Die zu sanierenden Gebäude C und D wurden in den Jahren 1978/1979 errichtet. Die beiden miteinander verbundenen Gebäude umfassen eine Nutzfläche von mehr als 6.000 m² und beherbergen überwiegend Werkstätten und Unterrichtsräume. Sie sind eingeschossig, nicht unterkellert und wurden in Massivbauweise mit Stahlbetontragwerk, Flachdächern und Sheddach-Elementen errichtet. Ein zweigeschossiger Holzlagerraum mit flach geneigtem Blechdach wurde 2005 an das Gebäude C angebaut. Die Baumaßnahme soll während des laufenden Schulbetriebs durchgeführt werden. Schmutz- und lärmintensive Arbeiten sind daher, soweit möglich, in die schulfreien Zeiten (z. B. Ferien oder unterrichtsfreie Nachmittage) zu legen. Die gesamte Aufgabenbeschreibung finden Sie in der Anlage 01 Verfahrensleitfaden. Die Fertigstellung und die Übergabe an die Schule sind spätestens für Dezember 2032 geplant.

Konkurso tikslas: Išrinkti geriausiai urbanistinius, architektūros ir funkcinius aspektus bei kitus reikalavimus, išvardintus Konkurso sąlygose, atitinkančius Konkurso objekto Nr. 1, Konkurso objekto Nr. 2 ir Konkurso objekto Nr. 3 architektūrinės idėjos projektus. Konkurso I-ą, II-ą, III-ią, IV-ą vietas užėmusiems dalyviams bus skiriamos piniginės premijos: I-ai vietai skiriama 12 000,00 Eur (dvylika tūkstančių Eur 00 ct.), II-ai – 10 000,00 Eur (dešimt tūkstančiai Eur 00 ct.), III-iai – 8 000,00 Eur (aštuoni tūkstančiai Eur 00 ct.), IV-ai – 6 000,00 Eur (šeši tūkstančiai Eur 00 ct.), įskaitant visus mokesčius. Perkančioji organizacija laimėjusiu nustato tik 1 (vieną) dalyvį, surinkusį daugiausiai balų, neatitikusį pašalinimo pagrindų ir atitikusį nustatytus kvalifikacijos reikalavimus, t. y. Konkurso laimėtoju yra laikomas I-ą vietą užėmęs projekto pasiūlymo dalyvis, su kuriuo Perkančioji organizacija, vadovaudamasi VPĮ 71 str. 4 d. nuostatomis, po Konkurso numato vykdyti neskelbiamas derybas (žr. projekto konkurso sąlygose.). Konkurso objektai į dalis neskaidomi – tiekėjas turi siūlyti Konkurso objektus visa apimtimi.

title: European Healthcare Environmental Cleaning (HEC) Services
description: 1. Amendment 0002 attached for Healthcare Environmental Cleaning Services in Germany. 2. Additional questions must be submitted to via email to hyun.j.townsley.civ@health.mil and elena.m.raspitha.civ@health.mil no later than 14:00 Central European Time on Monday, 21 September 2026. The Defense Health Agency (DHA) requires Healthcare Environmental Cleaning (HEC) Services at Military Treatment Facilities (MTFs) in Germany. HEC services are highly specialized, conforming to exacting medical industry standards for maintaining an aseptic space for the administration of healthcare ranging from clinical to surgical. HEC services include management activities such as planning, scheduling, cost accounting, report preparation and submission, establishing and maintaining records, quality control, and performance management. Anticipated performance locations: Landstuhl Regional Medical Center (LRMC) Landstuhl, Germany and its outlying health, dental and veterinary clinics (Baumholder, Kaiserslautern (Kleber/Pulaski), Wiesbaden) Medical Department Activity � Bavaria (MEDDAC-B) Vilseck, Germany and its outlying health, dental and veterinary clinics (Grafenwoehr, Hohenfels, Ansbach, Illesheim, Stuttgart) Rhine Ordinance Medical Center (ROBMC), Weilerbach, Germany All responsible sources may submit a proposal which will be considered by the agency.

title: Infantry Platoon Battle Course (IPBC) Fort Bragg, North Carolina
description: Project Number: 86262Infantry Platoon Battle Course (IPBC) Fort Bragg, North Carolina. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Savannah District is issuing an Invitation for Bid (IFB) W912HN26BA005 for project number: 86262 Infantry Platoon Battle Course (IPBC) Fort Bragg, North Carolina. Type of Contract and NAICS: This Acquisition is solicited using FAR Part 14, Sealed Bid Procedures for one (1) Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) contract. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 236220- Commercial and Industrial Building Construction, with size standard of $45M.Type of Set-Aside: This acquisition is being offered under Full and Open Competition using the NAICS code identified above. Construction Magnitude: In accordance with DFARS 236.204, the magnitude of this construction project is anticipated to be between $10M-$25M. Bid Due Date: 15 June 2026 - 11:00am EDT via PIEE. Site Visit: 27 May 2026 - 09:00am EDT. Period of Performance: The period of performance including all options is 720 Calendar Days after the issuance of the notice to proceed. Project scope: This requirement is for the construction of a standard Automated Infantry Platoon Battle Course (IPBC). Primary facilities include the IPBC, small arms range operations control area, control tower (small), operations/storage building, covered bleacher, covered mess, ammunition breakdown building, building information systems, and latrine pads. Post Construction Award Services (PCAS) will be provided. Cybersecurity Measures will be incorporated into this project. Sustainability/energy measures will be provided. Supporting facilities include electric service, site improvements, and information systems. Project files are Portable Document Format (PDF) files and can be viewed, navigated, or printed using Adobe Acrobat Reader. Contractors must register at the SAM website at https://sam.gov to download the solicitation for this project. If/when issued, Amendments will be posted to the above-referenced website for electronic downloading. This will be the only method of distributing amendments before closing; therefore, the Offerors must check the website periodically for any amendments to the solicitation. Registrations: System for Award Management (SAM)-Offerors shall maintain an active registration in the SAM database at https://sam.gov to be eligible for a Government contract award. If an Offeror is not actively and successfully registered in the SAM database at the time of award, the Government reserves the right to award to the next prospective Offeror. Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE): The only authorized transmission method for bids in response to the forthcoming solicitation is electronic via Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) Solicitation Module. No Other Transmission Method (E-mail, Facsimile, U.S. Postal Mail, Hand Carried, etc.) Will Be Accepted. Offerors must have an active Proposal Manager role in PIEE at https://piee.eb.mil/.Point of Contacts: For this acquisition, the contracting officer, Jason Scheil, whose e-mail address is Jeremiah.J.Scheil@usace.army.mil, and the Contract Specialist, Brandon Moore, whose e-mail address is brandon.p.moore@usace.army.mil. Amendment 0001 - The purpose of this amendment is to extend the bid opening date, revise and consolidate the Bid Schedule, clarify pricing instructions for Sandhills Utility Services, provide explicit Volume I submission instructions for Joint Ventures, and to publish the pre-bid site visit attendance roster. Amendment 0002 - The purpose of this amendment is to publish the CAD files and to extend the bid opening date. The link and passcode for the CAD files are in the amendment document. *Note: Files are only available for 7 days after the posting of this amendment on DoD safe. Amendment 0003 - The purpose of this amendment is to provide additional drawings and specifications.

title: Industry Day U.S. Merchant Marine Academy Campus Modernization
description: FALL FY27 INDUSTRY DAY U.S. Merchant Marine Academy Campus Modernization Industry Day Special Notice | Thursday, October 15, 2026 Event Overview The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), New York District, and the U.S. Merchant Marine Academy (USMMA) will host the Fall FY27 Industry Day from 11:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time on October 15, 2026. The hybrid event will bring industry, government, community organizations, and other interested attendees together with USMMA and USACE leadership for an updated view of the Campus Modernization Initiative, its strategic direction, and anticipated procurement activity. This event is open to the general public, and interested vendors. The FY27-FY28 forecast will emphasize the substantial heavy construction opportunities central to the modernization program while also addressing utility upgrades and complementary supporting and non-construction requirements. In-person participation is strongly encouraged. Prior registration is required for every attendee and closes at 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time on October 12, 2026. Event Information Event: USMMA Campus Modernization Fall FY27 Industry Day Date: Thursday, October 15, 2026 Event Time: 11:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time Check-In: Opens at 10:00 a.m.; in-person attendees should arrive no later than 10:45 a.m. to allow at least 15 minutes for networking before the program begins Location: U.S. Merchant Marine Academy, 300 Steamboat Road, Kings Point, NY 11024; enter through the main gate Format: Hybrid; in-person attendance is strongly encouraged. Registered virtual attendees will receive a Microsoft Teams link on October 13, 2026 Audience: All interested attendees age 16 or older (public attendees welcome) Registration Deadline: 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time, Monday, October 12, 2026 Theme: USACE Partnering with Industry and the Local Community Industry Day Highlights The Industry Day program will include the following: Welcome and Keynote Remarks: USACE leadership, USMMA Academy leadership, and invited guests will discuss the modernization program, acquisition approaches, and community impacts. Strategic Program Overview: A general USMMA overview and FY27-FY28 Campus Modernization update, including the strategic vision, updated waterfall chart, and local-government and community considerations. Heavy Construction Forecast: A focused review of the significant heavy construction opportunities expected to drive the modernization program. Specific project names, dollar ranges, and acquisition methods will be presented at the event rather than released in this notice. Supporting and Utility Requirements: Discussion of utility upgrades and complementary non-construction requirements that support successful delivery of the broader construction program. Executive Panel and Q&A: A moderator-led discussion with USMMA leadership, USACE program representatives, and USACE Contracting, including questions and topics submitted by industry. Doing Business with the Government: A practical session presented by the USACE Office of Small Business Programs. Campus Tour and Networking: A campus tour and opportunities to engage with program managers, technical staff, government representatives, community stakeholders, and industry peers. Advance Industry Questions: Industry partners may submit proposed questions or discussion topics for the executive panel to Zachery.A.Bernard@usace.army.mil no later than September 30, 2026. Registration and Access Information Registration is required for every attendee, regardless of affiliation or attendance method. Email the information below to Zachery.A.Bernard@usace.army.mil no later than 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time on Monday, October 12, 2026. Use the subject line "USMMA FY27 Industry Day Registration." One representative may register multiple attendees, but the required information must be provided separately for each person. Full legal name of each attendee Organization, company, or other affiliation, if applicable Individual email address and telephone number for each attendee Attendance method: in person or virtual Company website, if applicable Current capability statement for industry participants Virtual Attendance: A Microsoft Teams link will be emailed to registered virtual attendees on October 13, 2026. In-person attendance is strongly encouraged. Campus Access Requirements All in-person attendees must present a valid REAL ID-compliant credential or another form of government-issued photo identification acceptable to USMMA security and comply with all campus-entry instructions provided to registered attendees. Logistics and Parking Campus Entrance: Use the main gate at 300 Steamboat Road, Kings Point, NY 11024. Parking: Free attendee parking is available in Marvin Lot; overnight parking is not permitted. RESERVE BASIN MAINTENANCE DREDGING CONTRACT FOR SITES AT THE PHILDELPHIA NAVY YARD IN THE PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT PENNSYLVANIA AREA OF RESPONSIBILIY
description: The project consists of Maintenance Dredging within the North Side (Wharf N) of Reserve Basin and Schuylkill River Access Channel for the Government sites at the Philadelphia Navy Yard in the Public Works Department Pennsylvania area of responsibility. Maintenance dredging of approximately 96,611 cubic yards of sediment, using a sealed environmental clamshell bucket. Dredging within the Reserve Basin is in support of the Naval Support Activity Mechanicsburg, Philadelphia Navy Yard Annex. The Reserve Basin is being used to decommission various US Naval vessels. For the river pilots to be able to safely maneuver vessels through the Schuylkill River into the Reserve Basin berths and to ensure that tidal cycles will not cause sediment accumulation around the hulls making final removal very difficult, the berths need to be dredged to a minimum depth of -30 MLLW and a maximum over-dredge depth of -32 MLLW.

title: USCG Cutter Eagle New Dredging for Berthing at New London City Pier
description: Eagle Pier New Dredging (FY26) at New London�s City Pier, CT (NEW LONDON COUNTY), PSN #24014900. Contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, materials, and all other items and services required to perform dredging of a new area immediately south of CGC EAGLE�s berth at New London�s City Pier. The intent is to deepen the area to allow tugboats to assist the cutter for mooring/unmooring at all tide levels. Requirements of the design specify dredging to a depth of -17.0� at Mean Lower Low Water (MLLW) +2.0� over dredging allowance. This equates to approximately 3,700 cubic yards (CY) of dredge spoils to remove to an upland disposal site. Offshore disposal is not permitted due to environmental sample analysis of the dredge area. There is an environmental time of year restriction in Connecticut that only permits dredging activities between October 1st and March 1st. SPECIAL NOTES: The contractor shall conduct dredging operations so that navigation through the channel is possible at all times. The scope of work also includes removals of approximately 50 piles that remain below the waterline. Any piles that cannot be fully removed are to be cut at -21.0� MLLW. Dredge quantity of 3,700 CY. This estimate is based on an average of the past annual dredging and surveys. The Contractor shall provide a cost for dredging per cubic yard. That per cubic yard cost will be used for any necessary contract cost adjustment resulting from dredging more or less than the estimated 3,700 cubic yards, within the limits of dredge. Contractor will be compensated for actual quantity of dredge material removed and disposed, within the limits of dredge, as shown on the plan sheets. Dredge disposal site location is to be determined by conditions of treated/non-treated piles for Base bid item and Option Bid item. The estimated value of the procurement is between $1,000,000 and $5,000,000. A 20% bid guarantee is required. Performance and Payment bonds will be required. The performance period is estimated to be 300 calendar days from issuance of Notice to Proceed. This acquisition is issued pursuant to FAR Part 14 Sealed Bidding and is 100% Set-Aside for Small Business concerns. All relevant solicitation documents, including specifications and drawings may be accessed for download beginning on the date of issue of the IFB at the following site: https://www.sam.gov. title: Solicitation - Fort Hood GOCO Aircraft & Ground Fuel Services
description: Interested companies responding to the solicitation will be required to register in the System for Award Management (SAM) and Wide Area Workflow (WAWF). This is a follow-on solicitation notice to sources sought notice SPE603-25-R-5X24 and SPE603-25-R-0525. This solicitation notice is for Fuel Operations Services to include managing, maintaining, and operating Government-Owned, Contractor-Operated (GOCO) facilities and equipment at Ft. Hood, TX. The Contractor will ensure safe, accurate, and timely handling, quality control, and accountability of all Defense Working Capital Fund (DWCF)-owned petroleum products under their control. The Contractor will perform required maintenance to ensure facilities, associated systems, vehicles, and equipment remain operational to meet the base mission. The Contractor will comply with environmental protection, safety, and security directives. The Contractor will conduct required training to ensure personnel are fully qualified to perform Performance Work Statement (PWS) tasks. Tasks identified in the PWS are performed by either the Contractor or Government as specified in Section C-2.0 Performance Requirements. The Contractor shall conduct all necessary fuels operations to support base operations, airshows and special events, deployments, exercises, and contingencies under normal conditions, as well as, during periods of heightened security, inclement weather, or other unique situations. Operations must be safely and efficiently conducted to receive, store, transfer, issue, and account for products with appropriate controls to ensure fuel quality, maintain inventory accuracy, and ensure no environmental impact. The Contractor shall operate and maintain the self-service automated service station facilities, equipment, and systems and ensure sufficient product is available to provide 24 hours a day, seven days a week support of ground fuels. The Contractor shall perform required tasks to ensure fuel is properly accounted for and issued to only authorized users. The NAICS Code for this procurement is 493190 and will be 100% set aside for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business. The period of performance is a four-year base period from December 1, 2026, through November 30, 2030, with a five-year option from December 1, 2030 through November 30, 2035, and a six-month option extension provision, December 1, 2035 through May 31, 2036. The Government anticipates awarding one Firm-Fixed Price contract. This information is subject to modification and in no way binds the Government to award a contract.
